resetOtp.subject: Password Reset Request
resetOtp.title: Password Reset Verification
resetOtp.intro: We received a request to reset your password. Here is your verification code:
resetOtp.expiry: This code expires in {{minutes}} minutes. If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email.

resetDone.subject: Your SalonOx Password Has Been Reset Successfully
resetDone.title: Password Reset Confirmation
resetDone.body: Your SalonOx account password has been successfully reset.
resetDone.loginNote: You can now log in to your SalonOx account using your new password.
resetDone.securityBody: If you did not request this password reset, please contact our support team immediately — your account may be at risk.
resetDone.footerAuto: This is an automated security notification. Please do not reply to this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to SalonOx, {{name}}! 🎉
welcome.intro: Congratulations! Your SalonOx account for {{salon}} has been successfully created. We're thrilled to have you on board.
welcome.about: SalonOx helps you manage appointments, staff, clients, and grow your salon business — all from one place.
welcome.step1Body: Add your salon details, logo, and working hours.
welcome.step2Body: Set up your service menu and invite your team members.
welcome.step3Body: Share your booking link and watch appointments roll in.
welcome.footer: You received this email because you created an account on SalonOx.
